U myntri rangbah jong u, u kyrteng Birbol, u sbong ha kata hi kajuh ka shnong. Man ka sngi u Patsha u ju lum Dorbar bad ki myntri ki korbari kiba synshar ia ka hima bad barabor u shah shkor ia ki khubor bad ai hukum ia kiei kiei da lade hi. Ha kawei ka sngi u Patsha u la kylli ha la ki myntri kumne: “Hato dei kaei ha ka pyrthei kaba thiang tarn eh na kiei kiei baroh ?” Man u rangbah uba ia shong hangta, don uba ong ka ngap, don uba ong ka shini, don uba ong ka mithai bad don kiwei de kiba ong da kibn bun jaideh kiba syriemkum kita; hynrei u Birbot u la ong, ‘‘Ka ktien, tarn na kane ym don ei ei shuh ha kane ka pyrthei.” Hangta ki )a ia rkhie

baroh haw, ki ong, “Ka ktien ; ka don jingmadB mu sha ?” U Birbor u la lihu si^p noK jar ha ka^ ba ki leh kumba rkhie beifi ia ka jisngiathi^ 3 ». Kim tip ka thew haduh katno kata kaba u ong. Nadien kata ynda la dap ar taiew, haba ki la ia klet bha ia kata kaba kylli u palsha, u Birbol u la khot ia u Patsha, bad ia kita ki myntri jong u baroh ban wan bamja sha i'ing jong u. U JAGADISH ClI VNDRA BOSE U Jagadish Chandra Bose u dei iiwei na ki riewstad jong ka ri India ba pawnam ha ka g yrthei. la u la kha ha Vikrampore, ha East Bengal ha ka 30 tarik u November, 1858. K.i phah ha i skul rit iba don hangta ha i nongrit iba ki shong, khnang ba un nang pule bha ia la ka jong ka ktien. bad ia ka Sanskrit. Kane hadien ka long kaei kaei kaba pynsngewtynnad bad myntoi shibun ia u Jagadish Bose. Da kaba u nang bha ia la ka jong ka ktien bad ka Sanskrit u lah ban pule ia ki kot ba paw- nam jong ka ri India bad ban tip bha ia ka jing- stad kaba don ha la ka jong ka ri. Kawei de ka jingmyntoi ba u Jagadish Bose « ioh ha i skul nongkyndong jong u ka longba u ioh ban ialang lok bad ki khynnah nongkyndong kiba thong hangto. Ki kmie ki kpa jong kine ki khyn- nah ki long kiba trei sha lum sha wah sha khlaw tha btap, bun de na ki dei ki nongtongdohkha. Ha skul ki iathuh- 8 khana la u JagacUsh Bose ia ki dohkha ba itynnad bad ki dieng ki siej kiba phylla ba ki iohi ha ja^wah bad ki khlaw, U Jagadisb Bose u sngewtynnad bha ia ki jingiathuhkhana jong ki bad katba u nang rangbah u nangkwah ban tip shuh shuh shaphang ki jingkylla kiba don ha ka mariang.

Ynda u la dep pule ha ki skul kiba don hapoh shnong, u Jagadish Bose u leit shi por ha kawei ka skul phareng. U pass ia ka B.A, na St.Xavier’s ha Calcutta bad tang shu pass u leit sha Bilat ban pule Science. Ha Bilat u Jagadish Bose u ia kynduh bad bun ki riewstad. Ha ka pule dangle ruh u la nangroi nangroi namar ha k skul bah kiba shato ki don laboratory kiba bha ba bha bad kane ka iarap shibun ia u haba u kwah ban wad jingtip bad sngewthuh ia ki science ba u pule. Ha ka snem 1884 u pass ia ka B. A. na Cambridge University bad ia ka B.Sc na London University. U wan noh sha India bad trei kum u professor ha Presidency College, Calcutta. Ha kane ka kam u Jagadish Bose um don jingsngewtynnad khyndiatruh ha kaba nyngkong. Ia u ki ai ka tulop kaba poh bha. ihn dep shna ia ka laboratory ha College, u sdang l)an wad jingtip kaba kham janai shaphang ki Science ba u hikai. U kwah barabor ban leit sha Europe namar hangta don lut ki tiar ki tar kiba u donkam bad ban ia kynduh bad ki riewstad kiba don shata.

Hadien li ioh lad, Ka Sorkar India ka phah ia u sha Europe khnang ban leit khniih ia ka jingfoi jong ka Science sha ri sepngi. U leit nyngkong ba England bad n ia kyndmi bad bud 10 Ici briew kiba la tip lypa ia ki jtpgtrei jong u. Kat shaba u leit ki bricw ki ia sop tylli ia u ban sngap ia ki jinghikai jong u Ynda u wan pat sha India ruh u laid man ki University bad b.atai ia ki jingshem ba phylla jong u. U ong bad pyni ha baroh kiba leit sngap ia u ba ym don jingiapher ei ei hapdeng ka mynsiem briew bad ka mynsitm jong ki jingthung jingtep. Ki jingthung jingtep ruh ki thiah bad shong thait kumba leh hi ki briew bad ki mrad. Ka por thiah jong ki jingthung ka dei naduh shiteng sngi haduh phra baje mynstep.
